name: Cyclone Thane
impactNotes: Severe canopy stripping at Pichavaram estuarine mangroves; high storm surge inundation along Cuddalore shoreline.
sourceOrganization: India Meteorological Department (IMD eAtlas / RSMC New Delhi)

name: Cyclone Nilam
impactNotes: Barrier dune scouring at Pulicat lagoon; localized beach erosion along Northern Tamil Nadu coast.

name: Cyclone Vardah
impactNotes: Choked barrier island inlets at Pulicat; structural tree uprooting in coastal urban green buffers.

name: Cyclone Ockhi
impactNotes: High wave energy scouring along Tamiraparani estuarine mouth at Punnakayal; coral & seagrass bed turbulence.

name: Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Gaja
impactNotes: Devastating canopy collapse across 5,000+ ha at Muthupet lagoon; Avicennia tree mortality due to persistent sediment burial post-surge.
sourceOrganization: India Meteorological Department (IMD) & TN Forest Dept Gaja Report

name: Severe Cyclonic Storm Nivar
impactNotes: Tidal inundation across Kazhuveli brackish wetland; extreme short-term rainfall surge flushing estuarine channels.

name: Severe Cyclonic Storm Mandous
impactNotes: High storm wave run-up along Coromandel beach dunes; localized siltation at Kazhuveli outlet.

name: Severe Cyclonic Storm Michaung
impactNotes: Record extreme precipitation (>400 mm in 24 hrs) causing massive freshwater dilution in Pulicat lagoon.
